title: Giving a Direction: the Imperative of megy

sections.content: To tell someone to go somewhere, Hungarian uses the imperative form menj, built from the irregular stem of megy rather than by adding an ending to megy itself.
menj looks unrelated to megyek/megyünk because megy is irregular -- its imperative doesn't follow the normal pattern of adding -j to the present stem, so it has to be learned as its own form.
